DNS and tunnel status fixes, with a focused set of AI presets.

- Retry a DNS check once after a transient connection failure. Close stale SOCKS UDP associations promptly when the core restarts.
- Reset awg1 and awg2 status together after DNS changes. Show a clear waiting or checking state until the new core has checked both tunnels.
- Ship six AI services (ChatGPT/Codex/Sora, Claude, Google AI, Grok, Meta AI, Copilot) and a separate shared sign-in preset. Shared endpoints use exact names; service domains keep broad masks.
